context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: E-commerce Checkout Implementation.

checklist.name: Given/When/Then format
checklist.description: Uses Given/When/Then structure for checkout flow scenarios rather than rule-oriented format

checklist.name: Measurable timing
checklist.description: Includes specific timing requirements with precise measurements (e.g., `<= 3 seconds`, `within 500ms`)

checklist.name: Observable outcomes
checklist.description: Then statements describe what user can observe or measure, not internal system behavior

checklist.name: Negative scenarios
checklist.description: Includes failure scenarios like payment declined, timeout, or invalid input

checklist.name: Single action When
checklist.description: When statements contain single, clear actions that trigger behavior being tested

checklist.name: Essential Given setup
checklist.description: Given statements include only prerequisites that matter, avoiding irrelevant setup details

checklist.name: User behavior scenarios
checklist.description: Scenario names describe user behavior (e.g., `User completes checkout`) not system features

checklist.name: Out of scope section
checklist.description: Includes explicit `Out of Scope` section to define boundaries and prevent scope creep

checklist.name: Checkbox format
checklist.description: Uses checkbox format (`- [ ]`) for criteria to enable clear pass/fail validation

checklist.name: User outcome focus
checklist.description: Focuses on user outcomes and business value rather than implementation details
